gates.G1_runner: Rows 1 and 6 are my own example.com brackets. If either is not ok/200, or the relay's own control row is not ok, or void is true, the batch is VOID as to every content row.

gates.G5_status_is_not_source_state: CARDINAL. A refused/403, a 404, or a find_matched:false is a statement about this client's access at that instant, or about a string in one rendering at that instant. NONE may be restated as a fact about a case, an award, a proceeding, a treaty, or a document's existence. In particular: nothing in this batch may found a claim that A/81/17 has or has not been issued, that any Einarsson document was or was not filed, that any Zeph document was or was not filed, or that the China–Switzerland BIT does or does not contain a denial-of-benefits clause.
gates.G6_rendered_text_only: The relay strips every tag AND attribute (scripts/fetch_relay.py:126-128). A string present only in an href or an attribute is INVISIBLE to this channel. Every find_matched:false below carries this limit.
gates.G7_entity_blind: Per 0806-O6 (standing): the find is a literal case-insensitive substring test. A string rendered with an HTML entity, a curly quotation mark where a straight one was asked, or a non-ASCII solidus reads as absent. Both window-slide anchors below were chosen to be pure ASCII precisely to keep this risk off the row.
gates.G8_edge_fragment: Per EDGE-FRAGMENT AS DESIGNATOR (adopted 2026-08-15, 0815-O3): a string sitting at the right edge of a returned window is a FRAGMENT and must never be used as a subsequent find. Neither anchor below is an edge fragment; each was bounded on BOTH sides in the window that produced it, and the row notes say which window that was.
